dedupe_keys.name: false data injection attack dataset for the industrial internet of things ukmnct iiot fdia

description: UKMNCT_IIoT_FDIA is a dataset of Industrial Internet of Things traffic and telemetry for studying false data injection attacks. The DataCite record says it gathers network, operating system and telemetry data for threat intelligence, intrusion detection, adversarial machine learning and privacy-preserving models, and the IEEE DataPort page says it is one CSV file with 26 features such as ports, DNS fields, HTTP body lengths and MIME types, connection state and TLS issuer and subject. It was submitted by AKM Ahasan Habib and Mohammad Kamrul Hasan of Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia and last updated on 29 November 2024. DataCite gives the licence as CC BY 4.0, but the page marks it a Standard Dataset, so the file needs an IEEE DataPort subscription (US$40 a month, free for IEEE Society members). Coverage is one IIoT test setup. Caveats: the physical process behind the telemetry, the number of rows and the attack labels are not stated on the pages read, and the features are mostly network-level. For simulation it gives labelled attack traffic to test detectors that would stop falsified sensor values from reaching plant control models. Related catalogue records include the ICS-ADD smart industry testbed data and the KNXnet/IP intrusion detection dataset.
